title: Playwright · TypeScript
description: UI + API test automation with Playwright Test — locators, web-first assertions, fixtures, POM, auth, mocking, visual, CI. Runs against a local practice app.

prerequisites.title: Playwright Test setup (as the hub runs it)
prerequisites.install: npm init playwright@latest   # or: npm i -D @playwright/test@1.64.0 && npx playwright install --with-deps

runner.title: Test runner
points: Each test gets a fresh BrowserContext (isolated cookies/storage).
Actions auto-wait for actionability; web-first assertions retry.
Workers are processes — tests must not share state.

gate.title: How the gate checks you
points: Static rules on your code (TypeScript AST): locators, awaits, sleeps, weak assertions, required APIs.
Your tests run 3× — any mixed result is reported as flaky.
The app is re-run with a planted bug; a good test must fail there.

ci.title: CI & scale
points: Run in mcr.microsoft.com/playwright for identical browsers.
